sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Unstable lava rocks are resource nodes found in the Ashlands biome, being a source of Proustite powder.
When destroyed by receiving 50 or more damage from any weapon or a pickaxe, they explode. The explosion damages surrounding objects, including players, creatures and structures. Additionally, it creates a small crater in the ground.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: Unstable lava rocks can often be found attached to large boulders and stones in the Ashlands biome, as well as on the ground occasionally.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• The explosion deals 75 pure damage, regardless of armor rating, and is unblockable. It also deals 500 Chop and 600 Pickaxe damage, but the player is immune to these types of damage.
• The explosion has a tool tier of 4, one higher than Black metal.
• Unstable lava rocks can be safely destroyed by shooting them with a bow or crossbow. Frost arrows are particularly efficient.
